news.title: PAIN WITH A PUBLICIST Grim is the word. There is a real human sadness underneath the theat…
news.author: Robinzz3@mastodon.au
news.snippet: PAIN WITH A PUBLICIST Grim is the word. There is a real human sadness underneath the theatre. Harry may be privileged, irritating, badly advised, and responsible for his choices, but he still looks to me like a man trying to turn pain into meaning in public. That is a dangerous business. And Meghan, whatever I may think of her, may also be trapped inside her own self-image. That can make people ruthless, but it does not make them free. A bubble is not just privilege. It is any closed system where only the approved story is allowed to breathe. If I want to be included, I have to include "the others" too. Not as props. Not as enemies. Not as proof of my grievance. As actual people. That seems to be the missing thing in the whole drama. The family are real people. The press can be vile, but they are not simply demons. The public are not obliged to keep feeding anyone’s wound. Everyone is caught in a bubble until something cracks it. And wounds are supposed to heal. That is their nature. They close when they are not constantly scratched open for identity, drama, money, meaning, or moral leverage. Harry probably needs silence more than victory. No interviews. No lawsuits. No brand. No crusade. Just time out. Let the wound be a wound. news.title: I don’t even bother engaging with people who write starry-eyed posts about how they tried …
news.author: drahardja@sfba.social
news.snippet: I don’t even bother engaging with people who write starry-eyed posts about how they tried an LLM and found that it worked super well for them, and proceed to refer to the bots as “he” or “she” any more. I think a chatbot’s illusion of intelligence is incredibly potent for people who aren’t inoculated against it. Those who were (un)lucky enough to experience a successful initial interaction can be smitten so hard that they immediately become a true believer, and will double down on chatbots, until they take the time to reflect on how poorly it actually performs most of the time, which won’t happen for a very long time. AI psychosis is a real trap, and I don’t know how I can help people who have recently fallen into it. So I Unfollow. Mute. Move on. Best I can do. # ai # llm
